title: ExplorationRound
description: Output from one round of iterative exploration of a Feldenkrais lesson analysis

annotations.description: Annotations anchored to specific groups/steps in the analysis

anchor_group.description: Group number this annotation is anchored to

anchor_step.description: Step number within the group (null if annotation is about the group as a whole)

text.description: The annotation content — must add insight, not restate the analysis

confidence.description: How confident are you in this annotation (0=speculative, 1=certain)

step.description: Optional specific step within the group

label.description: Short descriptive label for this exploration direction

why.description: Why this area is worth exploring

meta_observation.description: A high-level observation about the lesson or the exploration so far
